column3: (2) Every person arrested by or apprehended
and  handed  over  to  the  police  officer  in
pursuance  of  subsection  (1),  shall  be  brought
by  the  police  officer  as  soon  as  practicable
before the Magistrate having jurisdiction over
the area in which the offence was alleged to have
prosecution against any person for any offence
under this section may be commenced and on
conviction,  he  shall  be  liable  to  a  fine  not
exceeding  twenty  five  thousand  rupees  or
imprisonment not exceeding six months or  both
